description_en: Queries the quota usage and limits for a KMS instance
kebab_example: aliyun kms get-kms-instance-quota-infos --kms-instance-id kst-bjj62f5ba3dnpb6v80000 --resource-type key --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetKmsInstanceQuotaInfos

parameters.help_en: The ID of the KMS instance to query
parameters.name: kms_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

`key`: key quota

`secret`: secret quota

`qps`: queries per second (QPS) quota

`vpc`: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) quota
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。取值：

key：密钥配额

secret：凭据配额

qps: qps配额

vpc: vpc配额
parameters.name: resource_type
